title: Redirection Review
description: A documented profile of Redirection for managing 301 redirects and monitoring missing URLs during site changes.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped Redirection WordPress plugin profile from KreativWP.
highlights: The WordPress.org listing describes 301 redirect management and 404 error monitoring
Redirect groups and logs support migration and maintenance workflows
Redirect rules should be treated as a deliberate mapping, not a substitute for fixing internal links
bestFor: Migrations, URL restructures, and sites that need an auditable approach to discontinued URLs.
researchScope: This profile reviews Redirection’s WordPress.org listing and official project materials. It does not test a large redirect migration.
caveats: Avoid redirect chains and bulk rules without a tested URL map. Review logs regularly, then remove obsolete rules where appropriate.
